device_selection_reason: CUDA is not available in this environment (torch is a +cpu build and torch.cuda.is_available() is False). The device decision is therefore forced, not chosen. No new framework build was installed in this phase.
determinism_policy: upstream-faithful: torch.manual_seed only, matching Phase 3.3. use_deterministic_algorithms is NOT enabled, because enabling it would depart from the frozen official-baseline pipeline.
thread_count_policy: torch.set_num_threads(8) pinned explicitly at process start in every run, so BLAS reduction order does not vary between arms with machine load
no_device_switch_rule: once the first model training begins, no CPU/CUDA switch is permitted. If the environment fails materially mid-experiment the phase STOPS; a restart under another device is a new versioned experiment.
